The *Mettagūmāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 8) is an exegetical text belonging to the *Cūḷaniddesa* section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya, presenting a canonical commentary and word-by-word exposition of the questions posed by the student Mettagū (*Mettagūmāṇavapucchā*) [SuttaCentral].
Curated passage-level parallels identified on SuttaCentral link the work to numerous other commentaries within the Niddesa corpus, including the *Guhaṭṭhakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 2), *Purābhedasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 10), *Mogharājamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 19), *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 14), *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23), *Kāmasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 1), *Puṇṇakamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 7), *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 16), *Māgaṇḍiyasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 9), and *Paramaṭṭhakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 5), along with resembling parallels in the *Mahābyūhasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 13), *Ajitamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 5), and *Pārāyanānugītigāthāniddesa* (Cnd 22) [SuttaCentral]. Related verses and phrases are also cross-referenced in other canonical and early Buddhist works, including the *Dhammapada* (Dhp 268–269, 321–323) and its Chinese, Sanskrit, and Gāndhārī parallels (such as T 210, T 212, T 213, the Patna Dharmapada, the Gāndhārī Dharmapada, and the Udānavarga traditions), as well as suttas in the *Dīgha Nikāya* (DN 33), *Majjhima Nikāya* (MN 140), *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 3.122, AN 6.1), *Itivuttaka* (Iti 67), and *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 3.2) [SuttaCentral].

DharmaNexus also aligns segments of the text with non-Pali Buddhist literature, notably Tibetan translations such as the *Karmaprajñapti* (D4088) and the *Ārya-ānandagarbhāvakrāntinirdeśa* (D0057), Sanskrit works such as the *Mahāvyutpatti*, *Udānavarga de Subaši*, and *Divyāvadāna*, as well as discourses in the Chinese Āgamas (*Ekottarika-āgama* T 125, *Saṁyukta-āgama* T 99, and *Madhyama-āgama* T 26) [DharmaNexus].
